the_fix.what: Added `build_parser=True` param to CoResidentOneBrainComposer.__init__. When False, SKIP the idle BridgeParser shared-bridge merge entirely and set self.parser=None. MergedNavConvAgent passes build_parser=False on the onebrain path, because comprehension on the merged agent goes through `_MergedParserAdapter` (the framework parse_conj slice) — the composer's OWN parser is never used (LAYOUT decision 2b); it was pure redundant dead weight whose only effect was the destructive merge.

the_fix.why_byte_identical: The RF ops are RESET-ISOLATED from the parser: every composer op `_zero_rf_v_u()`-resets the rf slice's v/u to 0 before kicking (one_brain_composer.py:301-314, called at every op site), the complex `cp_rf_w_*` synapses are a SEPARATE array from the parser's `parse` `cp_connections` population, and the composer codes come from RFPhasorComposer(seed=...)'s own RNG (built BEFORE the parser). So whatever the parser's Hebbian training left on the bridge is wiped before any RF read, and dropping the idle parser leaves the composer's RF numerical OUTPUT identical.
